test_title: SSC Selection Post Matric Level Official Paper (Held On: 30 June, 2023 Shift 4)
subject: general
question: Despite giving 23% discount on the book, Raj makes 10% profit. If Raj earns Rs. 63 profit, then find the marked price of the book.
solution:
**Given:**

Discount (D)% = 23%

Profit (P)% = 10%

profit = 63

**Formula used:**

Cost price (C.P)/marked price (M.P) = (100 - D%)/(100 + P%)

Profit = Selling price (S.P) - Cost price (C.P) 

**Calculation:**

C.P/M.P = (100 - D%)/(100 + P%)

⇒ (100 - 23)/(100 + 10)

⇒ 77/110 = 7/10

Selling price (S.P) = 10 × (100 - 23)%

⇒ 7.7 units

Profit = S.P - C.P

⇒ 7.7 - 7 = 0.7 unit

⇒ 0.7 unit = 63

⇒ 1 unit = (63 × 10)/7 = Rs.90

⇒ M.P = 10 units = 90 × 10 = Rs.900

**∴ The correct answer is Rs.900.**
